title: Common
description: Shared primitives for contract v1. Every unit, range and enumeration used by more than one object is pinned here once; other schemas reference these definitions instead of restating them. See units.md for the same rules as a single table.

Zone.title: Zone
Zone.description: Room zone. Canonical order is left, center, right, professor. Left and right are as seen by the audience facing the board.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: ISO 8601 instant in UTC with a trailing Z. Producers emit millisecond precision, for example 2026-10-13T09:00:00.000Z. Consumers accept 0 to 6 fractional digits. Offsets such as +05:00 are invalid.

Brightness.title: Brightness
Brightness.description: Light output in percent of the zone maximum, integer 0 to 100. 0 is off, 100 is full output.

TemperatureC.title: TemperatureC
TemperatureC.description: Measured air temperature in degrees Celsius, one decimal place, -40.0 to 85.0.

TargetTemperatureC.title: TargetTemperatureC
TargetTemperatureC.description: Requested air temperature in degrees Celsius, one decimal place, 16.0 to 30.0.

HumidityPct.title: HumidityPct
HumidityPct.description: Relative humidity in percent, integer 0 to 100.

FanSpeed.title: FanSpeed
FanSpeed.description: Fan duty in percent of maximum speed, integer 0 to 100. 0 is stopped.

Volume.title: Volume
Volume.description: Speaker volume in percent, integer 0 to 100.

Confidence.title: Confidence
Confidence.description: Model confidence, number 0.0 to 1.0, at most 3 decimals.

FadeMs.title: FadeMs
FadeMs.description: Linear fade duration in milliseconds, integer 0 to 5000. 0 is an instant change.

CmdId.title: CmdId
CmdId.description: Device command identifier, generated by the engine, unique per link for at least 24 hours. Recommended form is c followed by 8 lowercase hex characters. Echoed unchanged by the device in its ack.

RequestId.title: RequestId
RequestId.description: Correlation id of one user request, voice or app. Created at wake word detection or at API entry and carried through transcript, intent, decision and reply.

LectureId.title: LectureId
LectureId.description: Lecture identifier, assigned by the API on creation.

DecisionId.title: DecisionId
DecisionId.description: Decision identifier, assigned by the engine.

DeviceId.title: DeviceId
DeviceId.description: Microcontroller identifier, esp32- followed by the last 6 hex characters of the MAC address, lowercase.

LightingMode.title: LightingMode
LightingMode.description: Lighting mode. auto follows occupancy and daylight, lecture and presentation apply the presets from Settings, manual holds per-zone values set by a person, off forces every zone to 0.

ClimateMode.title: ClimateMode
ClimateMode.description: Climate mode. auto drives the fan toward the target temperature, manual holds the last fan speed, off stops the fan.

RingPattern.title: RingPattern
RingPattern.description: LED ring animation. idle is a dim breathe, listening follows the wake word, thinking spins while the request is processed, speaking pulses during a spoken reply, success and error flash once and fall back to idle.

ComponentStatus.title: ComponentStatus
ComponentStatus.description: Health of a component or of the whole system. ok works as specified, degraded works with reduced function or stale data, down does not work.

Component.title: Component
Component.description: Process on the Pi that publishes to the event bus. bridge owns the serial link to the ESP32, recorder writes history.

BusTopic.title: BusTopic
BusTopic.description: Logical event bus topic. The full list with publishers, subscribers and rates is in bus.md.

ZoneLevels.title: ZoneLevels
ZoneLevels.description: One brightness value per zone, in percent 0 to 100.

ActionType.title: ActionType
ActionType.description: What the engine does as the result of a decision. lighting.set_zone with a null zone applies to every zone. answer only produces reply_text. none means nothing was done.

ActionParams.title: ActionParams
ActionParams.description: Parameters of an Action. Which keys are required depends on the action type, see the table in bus.md under control.request.

target_c.description: Target for climate.set_target, degrees Celsius 16.0 to 30.0.

speed.description: Fan speed for climate.set_fan, percent 0 to 100.

Action.title: Action
Action.description: A single change the engine is asked to make or has decided to make.

zone.description: Zone the action applies to, null when it applies to the whole room.

params.description: Action parameters, an empty object when the action has none.
